comments.body:
+1 Sundries Trading
female only, requires 3000 fame

5x Lace, 5x Embroidery Thread, 1x Fine Velvet using the Loom at national factories. The recipe requires r10 sewing and r8 management, but if you are at your own nation's factory only r6 management is required.

Part of Machine-made Clothes.
